name: TimeSaverBot – Multilingual AI Chatbot
author: TimeSaverBot

sections.description:
Someone lands on your site at 11pm with a question. If nobody answers within a couple of minutes, they buy from somebody else.

TimeSaverBot answers — instantly, around the clock, in whichever of the 46 languages they used.

Your visitors ask the same handful of questions all day, all night, all weekend — and some of them ask in a language you don’t speak.

TimeSaverBot reads your website and your WooCommerce catalog and answers those questions for you, from your own content. When a real person is genuinely needed, your team gets a warm lead with the whole conversation attached.

The plugin connects your site to the TimeSaverBot platform, and the setup wizard creates your account for you. No separate sign-up, no code, no theme edits — you are live in about five minutes.

🔥 30-day free trial. No credit card.

🌍 The bot speaks 46 languages and picks the right one itself

Most chat plugins give you a handful of languages and ask you to choose one. TimeSaverBot works out the language from your visitor’s first message and answers in it. A Polish visitor gets Polish. A Brazilian gets Portuguese. Nobody picks a setting.

Your content stays in one language — yours. The bot understands what a question means, not just the words it is written in. A visitor asks in Greek or Thai — the answer is built from the page you already wrote, and comes back in their language.

  • No translation plugin, no duplicate pages, no need for 46 versions of your FAQ
  • Works on the site you have today — nothing to restructure
  • Exact details still match exactly — model numbers, SKUs, brand names
  • Right-to-left done properly — for Arabic, Persian, Hebrew and Urdu the whole chat window mirrors, not just the text

From Arabic and Chinese to Polish, Portuguese and Thai — see the full list in the FAQ.

🛒 The bot knows your WooCommerce catalog

The plugin reads your products through WooCommerce’s own API. Here is what the bot knows about every product — and the questions it can answer as a result:

  • Price and sale price. “How much is it?” — “$24.90, on sale right now, normally $29.”
  • Stock, down to the last unit. Including the one that sold a minute ago to somebody else. Most integrations never notice that.
  • Variations. “Do you have it in blue, size 42?” — “Blue 42 is in stock, $24.90. Red 42 is sold out.”
  • Weight and package dimensions. “How heavy is it? Will it fit a parcel locker?” — “2.4 kg, and the box is 30 × 20 × 15 cm.”
  • Photo, brand, category, SKU and rating. The bot sends a real product card — picture, price and a button through to the product page, not a bare link. And it finds things the way customers ask for them: by brand, by product code, by category.
  • Sold-out products too. “Do you still have it?” — “It is sold out right now. Check back later, or leave your details.” Better than silence.

The bot can narrow things down, too: “show me something under $30”, “only what’s in stock”, “cheapest first”.

Create, edit or delete a product and the bot knows about it moments later — no waiting for an overnight update, nothing to re-import by hand. Import your whole catalog, or a single category with its subcategories.

🧭 Which bot is right for you?

Pick a ready-made Template — and the bot works out of the box.

  • 📈 General Sales — for services, B2B and landing pages. Answers from your site and walks visitors toward an inquiry or leaving their details.
  • 🎧 General Support — for sites with a knowledge base or documentation. Answers precisely and takes the load off your team.
  • 📅 Service Order — for appointment-based businesses: clinics, salons, repair shops. Collects name, phone, service and preferred time.
  • 🛒 E-commerce — for online stores. Advises on products from your catalog, helps compare them, answers questions about price, availability, delivery and payment, and guides people to order.
  • 🤖 Prompt Bot — for anything special. You describe the behavior yourself.

⚡ Live in about five minutes

  1. Activate the plugin. The wizard starts on its own.
  2. Pick the pages the bot should learn from. Your WooCommerce catalog imports at the same time.
  3. Choose one of the five ready-made bots above, or write your own instructions from scratch.
  4. Set your widget’s colors and text, with a live preview.
  5. Done. The widget is already on your site.

Every step after picking your pages can be skipped.

📚 The bot learns your site and always knows its current state

The bot learns from your pages — and keeps that knowledge fresh by itself.

  • Edit a page and the bot picks the edit up. Publish a new one and it is included straight away. Delete it and it drops out, so the bot never answers from a page that no longer exists.
  • Pages and posts all count — plus any custom sections you have, like Services or Projects
  • Re-scan the whole site, or just one page, whenever you want
  • Write FAQ answers by hand, or import them from CSV or JSON
  • Everything syncs in the background and never holds up your editor

💬 A widget that fits your site

  • The widget appears on every page automatically — no shortcode, no theme file to edit
  • Your colors, your button text, your chat title, previewed live in the wizard
  • Works on phones, tablets and desktops. On a small screen the chat opens out to fill it, instead of squeezing into a corner nobody can type in.
  • The chat runs in its own window inside your page, so your theme’s design can’t break it and it can’t break your theme

🎯 The bot turns conversations into customers

Chatting is not the point. Getting the business is.

TimeSaverBot asks the qualifying questions you would otherwise type out yourself, works out what the visitor actually wants, and takes their contact details before they click away.

  • If nobody is online, the bot still takes their contact details instead of losing the visitor
  • Your team picks up a conversation that is already half done

🖥 Everything from your WordPress admin

TimeSaverBot stays inside the admin you already use, instead of being one more tool bolted on to your site.

  • One click, no second login. Chat, Leads and your Knowledge Base open straight from the WordPress menu, signed in automatically — no extra password to remember.
  • Your numbers, right in wp-admin. Conversations, leads and conversion rate for the last 30 days.
  • Set it all up without leaving WordPress. The bot’s instructions, its tone, when it hands over to your team, and how the widget looks.

🔒 Safe by default

  • Your WordPress password is never sent anywhere
  • Every connection between your site and TimeSaverBot is signed, and opening Chat or Leads from the menu uses a one-time key that expires after 60 seconds
  • Your installation is tied to your domain — nobody can point it somewhere else
  • Delete the plugin and your setup is kept by default, so reinstalling puts everything back

💰 Pricing

30 days free, no credit card required. Every plan includes all 46 languages, even the cheapest one — you never pay extra for them. See current plans.

Third-Party Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on the TimeSaverBot SaaS platform hosted at app.timesaverbot.com. The following external connections are made:

  1. Provisioning API (POST /Provision/WordPressInstall) — Called once during the setup wizard to create your workspace. Sends: site URL, installation ID, WordPress version, plugin version, admin email.
  2. Dashboard Summary API (GET /Provision/WordPressDashboardSummary) — Called when loading the Dashboard page. Returns aggregated usage metrics.
  3. Operation Token API (POST /Auth/CreateOperationToken) — Called when you navigate to Chat, Leads, or Knowledge Base. Issues a short-lived authentication token.
  4. Iframe embeds — Bot Settings and Widget Settings pages load the TimeSaverBot configuration UI inside an iframe from app.timesaverbot.com.
  5. Silent login redirects — Chat, Leads, and Knowledge Base menu items redirect to app.timesaverbot.com with automatic authentication.
  6. Chat widget script (embed.js) — Loaded on every frontend page after wizard completion. The script is served from widget.timesaverbot.com and renders the chat widget inside an iframe. It sends your tenant ID and channel ID as data attributes.

All server-to-server API calls are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using a per-installation secret. No data is sent to any other third-party service.

  • TimeSaverBot Terms of Service
  • TimeSaverBot Privacy Policy

Privacy

TimeSaverBot connects to the TimeSaverBot SaaS platform at app.timesaverbot.com. This section documents all data transmitted.

Data sent during provisioning (one-time, on wizard completion)

  • Normalized site hostname (e.g. example.com)
  • Installation UUID (locally generated, not tied to any personal data)
  • Raw site URL, WordPress version, plugin version (diagnostic metadata)
  • Admin email address (used to create a technical user for your workspace)

Data sent during normal operation

  • Dashboard: HMAC-signed GET request with installation ID header. Returns aggregate metrics only.
  • Navigation (Chat/Leads/Knowledge Base): HMAC-signed POST request with installation ID and requested scope. Returns a one-time authentication token.
  • Settings (Bot/Widget): After initial authentication, the iframe communicates directly between the browser and TimeSaverBot. The WordPress plugin does not relay this traffic.

Data stored locally

Installation ID, HMAC secret, tenant ID, connector channel ID, process ID, wizard state. All stored in the wp_options table under the tsvbot_wp_settings key.

Data stored remotely

Chatbot configuration, conversations, leads, and usage metrics are stored on the TimeSaverBot platform. See the TimeSaverBot Privacy Policy for retention and deletion policies.

No additional third parties

This plugin does not transmit data to any service other than app.timesaverbot.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the timesaverbot folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Follow the setup wizard that appears automatically:
    • Start — Accept the terms and click “Start setup” to provision your workspace.
    • Scan — Pick which pages the bot learns from; they are scanned and indexed in the background. If WooCommerce is active, your catalog imports at the same time.
    • Template → FAQ — Choose a bot template, fine-tune it, set up the widget, review what the bot learned, and add FAQ answers. Each of these steps can be skipped.
  4. On the final step the widget is already live — open the Dashboard to manage your chatbot.
sections.faq:
Which languages does the chatbot speak?

46, detected automatically from what your visitor writes: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew, Arabic, Persian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Italian, German, Dutch, Afrikaans, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Polish, Czech, Slovak, Slovenian, Croatian, Bosnian, Serbian, Macedonian, Bulgarian, Albanian, Greek, Romanian, Hungarian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Turkish, Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Tagalog and Swahili.

You do not have to choose. The bot reads the language of the first message and answers in it, then stays in that language for the rest of the conversation.

The chat window’s own buttons and labels are translated even more widely — into 82 languages and regional variants.

Do I have to translate my site or my FAQ into 46 languages?

No — and this is the point. Write your pages and FAQ once, in the language you already work in. The bot compares questions and content by meaning rather than by words, so a question in any of the 46 languages finds the answer you wrote in yours, and comes back in the language it was asked in.

Do I need a multilingual plugin like WPML or Polylang?

No. Language detection happens per visitor and per conversation, independently of your site’s language or of any translation plugin. A single-language WordPress site still gets a chatbot that answers in 46 languages.

Does it support right-to-left languages?

Yes, properly. Arabic, Persian, Hebrew and Urdu mirror the entire chat window — bubbles, icons, the send arrow and menus, not just the text direction — and each has a fully translated interface. Individual messages set their own direction, so text mixing one of these languages with Latin product names, SKUs and prices still reads correctly.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes — and for most shops it is the main reason to install the plugin. Products are read through WooCommerce’s own API: prices, sale prices, stock, variations, weight, package dimensions, images, brand, categories, SKU and rating. Changes sync automatically when you create, edit or delete a product, including stock dropping because a customer placed an order. You can import your whole catalog, or one category with its subcategories.

WooCommerce is optional. Without it, everything else works exactly the same.

Do I need a TimeSaverBot account?

No. The setup wizard automatically provisions a workspace for your site. No separate registration or login is required.

How long does setup take?

About five minutes. Every step after choosing your pages can be skipped, and defaults are applied.

Do I have to edit my theme or paste a script?

No. After the wizard finishes, the plugin injects the widget into every frontend page for you. Deactivating the plugin removes it again.

Will it slow my site down?

No. The chat loads last, after the rest of your page is already on screen, so your visitors never wait for it. The plugin adds a single script to your site and bundles no assets or third-party libraries of its own, and the admin side only loads inside wp-admin.

What data is sent to TimeSaverBot during setup?

When you click “Start setup” in the wizard, the plugin sends:

  • Your site URL (normalized to a canonical hostname)
  • A unique installation identifier (UUID, generated locally)
  • Your WordPress version and plugin version
  • The admin email address (used to create a technical user in your workspace)

This is the only time these details are transmitted. Subsequent API calls use HMAC-signed requests that include only the installation ID in a request header.

What data is sent during normal usage?

  • Dashboard page load: A signed GET request fetches usage metrics (dialog counts, lead counts, plan info). No site content is transmitted.
  • Chat / Leads / Knowledge Base navigation: A signed POST request obtains a short-lived, one-time authentication token. The token is exchanged in the browser for a session — no WordPress credentials are shared.
  • Bot Settings / Widget Settings: These pages load inside an iframe. Configuration data is exchanged directly between your browser and TimeSaverBot — the WordPress plugin is not involved after authentication.

Where is my data stored?

Plugin settings (installation ID, secret, tenant IDs) are stored locally in WordPress options (wp_options table). Your chatbot configuration, conversations, and leads are stored on the TimeSaverBot platform. No data is stored on any other third-party service.

What happens when I deactivate the plugin?

All settings and your installation identity are preserved. Reactivating the plugin restores your connection to TimeSaverBot without re-running the wizard. Your workspace and data on TimeSaverBot remain intact.

What happens when I uninstall (delete) the plugin?

By default, your connection to TimeSaverBot (installation ID and setup) is kept on your site, so reinstalling restores everything automatically and the setup wizard does not run again. If you instead want deletion to remove all stored data from your site, enable the option under TimeSaverBot → Help → Data & Privacy before deleting the plugin. Either way, your workspace on TimeSaverBot is not deleted — contact TimeSaverBot support if you want your data removed from the platform.

Can I use this plugin on a multisite installation?

The plugin is designed for single-site WordPress installations. Multisite support is not currently available.

How does the chat widget appear on my site?

After completing the setup wizard, the plugin automatically injects the TimeSaverBot chat widget script into every frontend page via wp_footer. No manual code changes are needed. The widget does not appear on wp-admin pages. If you deactivate the plugin or reset the wizard, the widget is removed automatically.

The iframe pages are blank or blocked

See the Troubleshooting section on the Help page inside the plugin (TimeSaverBot → Help), or refer to the plugin’s SECURITY.md file for CSP/frame-ancestors configuration requirements.
sections.changelog:
1.1.14

  • Refreshes the WordPress.org listing description and screenshots.

1.1.13

  • Translates the plugin admin interface into 75 languages.

1.1.12

  • Adds a new e-commerce bot preset to the setup wizard.

1.1.11

  • Adds Bidspirit auction-lot import and search support, and includes product package dimensions alongside image and weight in search data.

1.1.10

  • Internal: the plugin version is now read from a single source, so the version reported to the service and shown in admin can no longer drift out of sync.

1.1.9

  • Fixed: the plugin now reports its correct version to the TimeSaverBot service and on the admin screen (it previously reported 1.1.0).

1.1.8

  • Setup wizard: the scan step now waits for the website scan to actually finish before revealing the extracted content, tells an unreachable backend apart from an empty result, and falls back to manual entry when the scan finds nothing or takes too long.

1.1.7

  • Setup wizard: preset bots now show their tone as read-only (baked into the preset) and no longer expose the custom-instructions field; only language and the leads/live-operator options remain configurable.

1.1.6

  • The General Sales bot now uses the final self-contained prompt for more consistent replies.

1.1.5

  • Plugin data (your TimeSaverBot connection and setup) is now kept when the plugin is deleted, so reinstalling restores it automatically without re-running the setup wizard. To remove all data on deletion instead, enable “Remove all TimeSaverBot data…” under TimeSaverBot → Help → Data & Privacy before deleting.

1.1.4

  • New: WooCommerce Product Sync — automatically import your product catalog into the knowledge base
  • New: products are synced via native WooCommerce hooks on create, update, and delete
  • New: full catalog import and category re-scan from the admin panel
  • New: WooCommerce product card UI in the plugin admin
  • Auto-import WooCommerce catalog from the wizard scan step
  • Renamed payload field: title → shortDescription

1.1.3

  • Adapted setup wizard to new wireframes — updated step labels, flow, and installation step descriptions

1.1.2

  • New: Website Sync — scan your site and send page content to the knowledge base, with a choice of whole-site or single-page scans
  • New: pending-send and pending-scan counts shown on the Website Sync screen
  • Automatically trigger a full site scan after setup completes
  • Last-scan time now displays using your WordPress date/time and timezone settings
  • Fix: address Plugin Check findings (input sanitization, gated error logging, tested-up-to)

1.1.1

  • Fix: point plugin API calls to api.timesaverbot.com (previously targeted app.timesaverbot.com, causing provisioning requests to fail with 405)
  • Updated Help page diagnostics to reference the correct API host

1.1.0

  • Automatic frontend widget injection — chat widget appears on all frontend pages after wizard completion
  • Widget absent on wp-admin pages and when wizard is incomplete
  • Added TSVBOT_WIDGET_URL constant (overridable in wp-config.php)

1.0.0

  • WordPress.org documentation and compliance: full readme.txt, privacy disclosure, security docs, Quick Start, troubleshooting guide
  • Help page expanded with detailed Quick Start and troubleshooting for 4 key failure scenarios

0.3.0

  • Wizard Stages 1-3 UI with iframe embeds, navigation controls, and completion flow
  • Dashboard page with settings status, plan and usage, last 30 days metrics
  • Silent login links for Chat, Leads, and Knowledge Base with redirect notice page
  • Iframe pages for Bot Settings and Widget Settings with embedded Nuxt UI
  • Audit logging for provisioning and authentication events
  • HMAC-SHA256 request signing with replay protection (timestamp + nonce)
  • Operation token and silent login exchange (short-lived, one-time tokens)
  • Call TimeSaverBot provisioning API on wizard Stage 0 to Stage 1 transition
  • Store tenant ID, connector ID, process ID, and installation secret in WP options
  • Add TSVBOT_API_URL constant (overridable in wp-config.php)

0.2.0

  • Generate and persist stable installation ID (UUID v4) across deactivation/reactivation
  • Normalize site URL to canonical host for stable identity binding

0.1.0

  • Initial plugin skeleton with activation/deactivation hooks
  • Setup wizard with Stage 0 intro page
  • Admin menu with 8 navigation items (Dashboard, Chat, Leads, Bot Settings, Widget Settings, Knowledge Base, Packages, Help)
  • Settings storage and version-based migration runner
